statement: let C := fun N : ℕ => (Finset.range N).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ N < 3*p ∧ 3*p < 2*N ∧ 1 < N-p ∧ N < (N-p).minFac^5); ∀ N z : ℕ, 1 ≤ z → z^5 ≤ N → z*((C N).filter (fun p => ¬ Squarefree (N-p))).card ≤ N

plain_statement.zh: 对任意自然数 N 和满足 1≤z、z⁵≤N 的整数 z，令 D 为中央粗糙候选集中补数有素数平方因子的候选数。则 zD≤N。
plain_statement.en: For all natural numbers N and z with 1≤z and z⁵≤N, let D count central rough candidates whose complement is divisible by the square of a prime. Then zD≤N.

brief.zh: 每个这样的补数 n 都有素数平方 q² 整除它，且 q>z。映射 p↦N−p 在候选集上单射。对 z<q≤√N 的所有整数 q，将各自的正倍数个数相加即得上界。用 1/q²≤1/(q−1)−1/q 求和。取 z 为 N 的五次方根的整数部分，得 D=O(N⁴ᐟ⁵)。Liouville 与 Möbius 和之差的绝对值、含重复素因子的三因子补数个数均至多为 D。
brief.en: Each such complement n has q² dividing n for some prime q>z. Reflection is injective on the candidates. Bound the count by summing the number of positive multiples of q² over all integers z<q≤√N. The inequality 1/q²≤1/(q−1)−1/q telescopes. Taking the integer part of the fifth root gives D=O(N^(4/5)). Both the absolute difference of the Liouville and Möbius sums and the count of triples with a repeated prime factor are at most D.
